in-jammu-kashmir.title: Flag of Jammu & Kashmir
desc: - The former flag of the Indian-administered state of Jammu & Kashmir featured a red field with a plough symbol
- **Construction:** a red field with three vertical white stripes near the hoist and a plough emblem in white
trivia:
- Jammu and Kashmir is a disputed territory between India and Pakistan
- The flag represents the Indian-administered region
- Pakistan claims the territory, and some areas are administered by Pakistan

in-tamil-nadu.title: Flag of Tamil Nadu
desc: - The unofficial flag of Tamil Nadu uses the DMK party colours — black and red — widely used as a state identity
- **Construction:** three equal vertical bands of black, red, and yellow (or gold). Sometimes a white disc or two leaves emblem appears on the red band
trivia:
- Tamil Nadu is a state in southern India
- The flag represents Tamil cultural identity and heritage
- Tamil is one of the world's oldest living languages

in-sikkim.title: Flag of Sikkim
desc: - The flag of the former Kingdom of Sikkim featured a Buddhist khorlo (dharma wheel) on a white field bordered by red and blue
- **Construction:** a white field with a red border and a Dharma wheel (khorlo) centred in red
trivia:
- Sikkim is a state of India in the eastern Himalayas
- Has its own distinct flag representing local identity
- Became a state of India in 1975
